30170-lonesome-hearts.title: Lonesome Hearts
30170-lonesome-hearts.creator: Russ Winterbotham
30170-lonesome-hearts.description: A book by Russ Winterbotham. I watched her with patronizing amusement. The static electricity showed that she was nervous and upset, but people often get nervous and upset over trivial matters. "Now, how," I reasoned, "could our world come to an end? The other planet has gone on for thousands of years without colliding with us.

arxiv-2102-10602.title: Distinction and Base Change
arxiv-2102-10602.creator: U. K. Anandavardhanan
arxiv-2102-10602.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by U. K. Anandavardhanan. An irreducible smooth representation of a p p -adic group G G is said to be distinguished with respect to a subgroup H H if it admits a non-trivial H H -invariant linear form. When H H is the fixed group of an involution on G G it is suggested by the works of Hervé Jacquet from the nineties that distinction can be characterized in terms of the principle of functoriality.

arxiv-2107-09331.title: Engineering the microwave to infrared noise photon flux for superconducting quantum systems
arxiv-2107-09331.creator: S.Sergey Danilin, J.João Barbosa, M.Michael Farage, Z.Zimo Zhao, X.Xiaobang Shang, J.Jonathan Burnett, N.Nick Ridler, C.Chong Li, M.Martin Weides
arxiv-2107-09331.description: Abstract Electromagnetic filtering is essential for the coherent control, operation and readout of superconducting quantum circuits at milliKelvin temperatures. The suppression of spurious modes around transition frequencies of a few GHz is well understood and mainly achieved by on-chip and package considerations.

arxiv-2204-10445.title: MTE with Misspecification Thanks: We thank Vitor Possebom, Yixiao Sun, Kaspar Wuthrich, and seminar participants at UC San Diego for helpful comments. All remaining errors are ours.
arxiv-2204-10445.creator: Julián Martínez-Iriarte, Pietro Emilio Spini
arxiv-2204-10445.description: Abstract This paper studies the implication of a fraction of the population not responding to the instrument when selecting into treatment. We show that, in general, the presence of non-responders biases the Marginal Treatment Effect (MTE) curve and many of its functionals.

arxiv-2402-00602.title: ICRC 2023 Gamma-ray Rapporteur Talk: a quick walk through the gamma-ray universe
arxiv-2402-00602.description: Abstract This document attempts to summarize the Gamma ray section of the 38th International Cosmic Ray Conference held in Nagoya. There were 387 contributions submitted to this section distributed in 22 parallel oral and three poster sessions, plus four related highlight or review talks.

arxiv-2502-17760.title: Probabilistic Dual Frames and Minimization of Dual Frame Potentials
arxiv-2502-17760.creator: Dongwei Chen
arxiv-2502-17760.description: Abstract . This paper studies probabilistic dual frames and associated dual frame potentials from the optimal mass transport perspective. The main contribution in this work shows that given a probabilistic frame, its dual frame potential is minimized if and only if the probabilistic frame is tight and the probabilistic dual frame is the canonical dual.

arxiv-2503-08466.title: Efficient Resource Allocation in 5G Massive MIMO-NOMA Networks: Comparative Analysis of SINR-Aware Power Allocation and Spatial Correlation-Based Clustering
arxiv-2503-08466.creator: Samar Chebbi, Oussama Habachi, Jean-Pierre Cances, Vahid Meghdadi, Essaid Sabir
arxiv-2503-08466.description: Abstract With the evolution of 5G networks, optimizing resource allocation has become crucial to meeting the increasing demand for massive connectivity and high throughput. Combining Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA) and massive Multi-Input Multi-Output (MIMO) enhances spectral efficiency, power efficiency, and device connectivity.

arxiv-2509-23463.title: Length-Matching Routing for Programmable Photonic Circuits Using Best-First Strategy
arxiv-2509-23463.creator: Xiaoke Wang, Dirk Stroobandt
arxiv-2509-23463.description: Abstract In the realm of programmable photonic integrated circuits (PICs), precise wire length control is crucial for the performance of on-chip programmable components such as optical ring resonators, Mach-Zehnder interferometers, and optical true time-delay lines. Unlike conventional routing algorithms that prioritize shortest-path solutions, these photonic components require exact-length routing to maintain the desired optical properties.

arxiv-2510-09788.title: Proof of the p p -adic Kazhdan-Lusztig hypothesis for GL ⁡ ( n ) \mathrm{GL}(n)
arxiv-2510-09788.creator: Kristaps John Balodis
arxiv-2510-09788.description: Abstract . In this article, we prove the p p -adic Kazhdan-Lusztig hypothesis for GL n ​ ( F ) \mathrm{GL}_{n}(F) . While the approach via graded affine Hecke algebras due to recent work of Solleveld leads to more general results, this article serves to completes and clarifies the approach via affine Hecke algebras of Chriss and Ginzburg.

arxiv-2601-14578.title: Higher Harmonics of Double White Dwarfs in the Centihertz Band: Linking LISA and DECIGO
arxiv-2601-14578.creator: Naoki Seto
arxiv-2601-14578.description: Abstract We investigate the detectability of post-Newtonian higher harmonics from Galactic double white dwarfs in the centihertz band ( ∼ 0.01 \sim 0.01 Hz). Using a synthetic population, we show that, unlike the quadrupole mode, higher harmonics remain undetectable with LISA except for rare nearby systems.

britannica-1911-saarlouis.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-saarlouis.description: Article 'Saarlouis' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 23), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Prussian Rhine Province, situated in a fertile district on the left bank of the Saar, and on the railway from Saarbrücken to Trier, 40 m. The town is well laid out and has spacious streets and a handsome market square.

pmc-10523639.title: Network pharmacology -based study on the mechanism of traditional Chinese medicine in the treatment of glioblastoma multiforme
pmc-10523639.creator: Chen Liang, Binbin Zhang, Ruichun Li, Shiwen Guo, Xiaoxuan Fan
pmc-10523639.description: BackgroundGlioblastoma multiforme (GBM) is one of the most common primary malignant brain tumors. Yi Qi Qu Yu Jie Du Fang (YYQQJDF) is a traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) prescription for GBM. The present study aimed to use a network pharmacology method to analyze the underlying mechanism of YQQYJDF in treating GBM.

pmc-10669049.title: Sensor Fusion-Based Anthropomorphic Control of a Robotic Arm
pmc-10669049.creator: Furong Chen, Feilong Wang, Yanling Dong, Qi Yong, Xiaolong Yang, Long Zheng, Yi Gao, Hang Su, Philippe Gorce
pmc-10669049.description: The main goal of this research is to develop a highly advanced anthropomorphic control system utilizing multiple sensor technologies to achieve precise control of a robotic arm. Combining Kinect and IMU sensors, together with a data glove, we aim to create a multimodal sensor system for capturing rich information of human upper body movements.

pmc-11460575.title: Acute kidney injury induced lithium toxicity with concomitant neuroleptic malignant syndrome
pmc-11460575.creator: Yin Ye Lai, Normaizuwana Mohamed Mokhtar, Intan Nureslyna Samsudin, Subashini C Thambiah
pmc-11460575.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Lithium, despite being an indispensable agent in the treatment of psychiatric disorders, has a narrow therapeutic index and needs to be carefully administered. Neuroleptic malignant syndrome (NMS) is a rare but potentially fatal complication due to central dopaminergic blockade. This case report illustrates the challenges in lithium therapy particularly related to the development of NMS when further risk factors such as polypharmacy and dehydration are present.

pmc-11486399.title: Prevalence and correlates of malaria and undernutrition among acutely febrile children visiting temporary malaria screening sites in war-torn areas of Northeast Ethiopia
pmc-11486399.creator: Habtu Debash, Ermiyas Alemayehu, Melaku Ashagrie Belete, Hussen Ebrahim, Ousman Mohammed, Daniel Gebretsadik, Mihret Tilahun, Agumas Shibabaw, Zewudu Mulatie, Bruktawit Eshetu, Saba Gebremichael, Alemu Gedefie, Luzia H Carvalho, Luzia H Carvalho, Luzia H Carvalho, Luzia H Carvalho
pmc-11486399.description: BackgroundMalaria and undernutrition pose challenges for children in conflict-affected areas. Understanding the prevalence and risk factors for these issues in war-torn communities is important to effectively design aid efforts and select interventions. This study aimed to determine the prevalence and correlates of malaria and undernutrition among febrile children in northeast Ethiopia to help address these problems.

pmc-11671878.title: Understanding occipital pressure sores in UK military casualties: a pilot study in healthy military personnel
pmc-11671878.creator: Panagiotis Chatzistergos, T E Scott, M Thorburn, N Chockalingam
pmc-11671878.description: IntroductionThe high prevalence of occipital ulcers in UK military casualties observed during the conflict in Afghanistan is a multifactorial phenomenon. However, the consensus is that ulceration is triggered by excessive pressure that is maintained for too long during the use of the general service military stretcher.

pmc-13230329.title: High-Intensity Training Increases Osteocalcin Levels: A Meta-Analysis of Effects of Exercise on Bone Remodeling biomarkers
pmc-13230329.creator: Viktória Barna, Amir Makolli, Zsuzsanna Pásztorné Benyó, Marie Anne Engh, Ádám Zolcsák, Brigitta Teutsch, Vivienne Seymour, Péter Hegyi, Renáta Papp, Nora Sydo, Péter Ferdinandy
pmc-13230329.description: BackgroundThe relationship between biomarkers of bone remodeling due to systematic training is not known, it is not possible to predict the optimal type and volume of exercise for bone remodeling.ObjectiveWe aimed to quantify the effects of systematic training on bone remodeling biomarkers, particularly osteocalcin and bone alkaline phosphatase in healthy adult populations.

pmc-13371282.title: Serum Midkine as a Biomarker for Hepatocellular Carcinoma Treatment Response and Prognostication
pmc-13371282.creator: Yanfang Luo, Qiuwei Lu, Jing Huang, Liejun Jiang
pmc-13371282.description: BackgroundUp‐to‐date tumor markers are considered more helpful in the evaluation of treatment response and prognostication than in diagnosis. Identification of a valid biomarker to help clinical management of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is still a challenge, especially in alpha‐fetoprotein (AFP) negative HCC.
